data.one_liner: Connect and communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy devices on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Flutter plugin for scanning, connecting, and interacting with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. It lets you discover services, read and write characteristics and descriptors, and listen to value changes.
use_when: You need to build a Flutter application that interacts with BLE peripherals
You want cross-platform BLE support for Android and iOS
avoid_when: You are looking for a stable API without breaking changes (the library is still evolving towards 1.0)
You only need standard networking or local storage
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of BLE actions (scan, connect, discover services, read/write characteristics and descriptors)
Stream-based architecture using rxdart for reactive state changes
weaknesses: API is subject to breaking changes as it moves toward version 1.0
Must be tested on a real device rather than an emulator for reliable BLE testing
data.setup_notes: Requires changing minSdkVersion to 19 for Android, adding Bluetooth and Location permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, and adding Bluetooth and Location usage descriptions in Info.plist for iOS.
